objective: Define the draft-engine request contract and immutable per-request configuration.
mathematical_spec: For request r, define C_r=(B_r,D_r,K_r,T_r,S_r) with beam/tree budget B_r>=1, max draft depth D_r>=1, per-node candidate cap K_r>=1, temperature T_r>0, and RNG seed S_r in uint64; reject configurations violating device limits before any decode work.
implementation_prompt: Specify C++ data structures and validation for the draft request contract. Keep the object immutable after admission, expose explicit limits needed by later tree-expansion modules, and add no execution policy beyond validation.

objective: Define the compact draft-tree node record used by all expansion stages.
mathematical_spec: Represent node i as N_i=(parent_i,token_i,depth_i,logp_i,path_i,flags_i), with parent_root=-1, depth_i=depth_parent+1, logp_i the local draft log-probability, and path_i an opaque stable identity.
implementation_prompt: Design the POD-style node record and invariants for parent linkage, token id, depth, local log probability, stable path identity, and lifecycle flags. Keep it GPU-copyable and independent of allocator policy.

objective: Define a contiguous tree arena layout for draft nodes and frontier metadata.
mathematical_spec: Let capacity M be fixed per request. Store nodes in indices [0,n), frontier indices F in a packed slice, and require n<=M, |F|<=M, parent_i<i for every non-root node.
implementation_prompt: Specify the arena metadata and contiguous buffers for nodes, parent indices, frontier indices, and counts. Define overflow behavior as an explicit status instead of implicit reallocation.

objective: Define stable path identifiers that survive frontier compaction and reordering.
mathematical_spec: For root path h_0=H(seed,0); for child c of node p with token t and child ordinal j, h_c=H(h_p,t,j,depth_c), where H is a deterministic 64-bit mixing function with negligible collision risk for runtime identity.
implementation_prompt: Specify deterministic 64-bit path-id derivation and collision handling. The API must produce identical IDs for identical logical expansion choices regardless of GPU scheduling order.

objective: Define draft-engine lifecycle states and legal transitions.
mathematical_spec: Use states EMPTY->SEEDED->EXPANDING->SEALED->CONSUMED, with ERROR terminal. A transition function delta(s,e) is defined only for legal state/event pairs and must never mutate sealed tree topology.
implementation_prompt: Specify the lifecycle enum, transition table, and state guards for request admission, root seeding, iterative expansion, sealing for verification, consumption, and failure.

objective: Define the draft-model execution adapter consumed by tree expansion.
mathematical_spec: For packed frontier size q and vocabulary size V, input contains q frontier descriptors plus token/position/context views; output logits L has shape [q,V] and row_to_node has shape [q], with row_to_node[r] equal to the frontier node represented by row r. Success produces exactly one logits row for every requested row.
implementation_prompt: Define the adapter around the existing draft llama_context/llama_decode path. Specify descriptor ownership, logits dtype/stride, row-to-node mapping, completion/status semantics, and unsupported-model fallback without introducing a parallel model executor.

objective: Define packed frontier descriptors for batched draft-model execution.
mathematical_spec: For frontier F=(f_0,...,f_{q-1}), descriptor arrays node[q], position[q], kv_ref[q], and sequence_slot[q] contain one entry per active frontier node. node[] has no duplicates, row r maps bijectively to node[r], position[r] is the next draft position, and kv_ref[r] must be valid for the referenced context generation.
implementation_prompt: Specify SoA or POD descriptor layout, exact integer widths, invalid sentinels, deterministic row order, inverse row mapping, and how tree metadata travels beside existing llama batch/ubatch fields rather than replacing them.

objective: Define reusable draft-step output buffers and shape metadata.
mathematical_spec: For q<=Q_max, vocabulary V, and K<=K_max, reusable logical buffers are logits[q,V], candidate_id[q,K], candidate_score[q,K], candidate_prob[q,K], valid_count[q], and optional RNG/output arrays. Allocation capacity is based on Q_max,V,K_max while each step publishes only its logical extents.
implementation_prompt: Specify buffer element types, strides, capacity versus logical shape, ownership, and reuse lifetime across expansion steps. Require zero per-depth heap growth after admitted runtime workspaces are allocated.

objective: Define cancellation and early-stop propagation through the draft runtime.
mathematical_spec: Let stop_r in {0,1}. Once stop_r=1 at a scheduler boundary, no new children may be appended; already materialized nodes remain readable and the tree may seal with its current topology.
implementation_prompt: Specify request cancellation/stop flags and the exact safe points where expansion observes them. Preserve already generated nodes and produce a valid sealable partial tree.

objective: Define draft-runtime error/status taxonomy for deterministic fallback.
mathematical_spec: Map each operation to status in {OK,CAPACITY,INVALID,MODEL,DEVICE,CANCELLED,UNSUPPORTED}; statuses are value-returned and must leave tree counts at the last committed boundary.
implementation_prompt: Define status codes and commit-boundary semantics so callers can fall back without inspecting partially appended children. Keep errors backend-neutral.

objective: Define stateless counter-based RNG semantics for per-node sampling.
mathematical_spec: Define u=U64_to_uniform(PRF(seed,domain_draft,request_id,path_id,depth,draw_ordinal)). The counter tuple is unique per logical draw and independent of frontier order, request batching, stream scheduling, and kernel launch shape; U64_to_uniform maps deterministically into [0,1).
implementation_prompt: Specify field widths, domain separation from verifier RNG, counter packing, uint64-to-uniform conversion, and CPU/GPU reproducibility. Reuse one shared counter-RNG ABI rather than defining a second RNG engine.

objective: Define temperature scaling and numerically stable categorical normalization.
mathematical_spec: For logits z[0:V) and T>0, set a_t=z_t/T for finite z_t and a_t=-inf for masked entries. Let m=max finite a_t; if no finite entry exists return INVALID. Otherwise p_t=exp(a_t-m)/sum_v exp(a_v-m), p_t=0 for -inf entries, and sum_t p_t=1 within numerical tolerance.
implementation_prompt: Specify accumulator precision, NaN/Inf policy, masked-entry handling, output representation, and exact post-transform probabilities consumed by later proposal accounting.

objective: Define deterministic top-k candidate filtering per frontier row.
mathematical_spec: For row scores a[0:V), let k_eff=min(k,n_finite,V). Return token[0:k_eff) and score[0:k_eff) ordered by score descending then token id ascending. NaN is INVALID input; -inf entries are excluded; k=0 returns an empty valid candidate set.
implementation_prompt: Specify exact candidate arrays, stable tie-breaking, k boundary cases, finite handling, and deterministic equivalence to the shared top-k reference used by downstream kernels/tests.

objective: Define nucleus top-p filtering over an already score-sorted candidate set.
mathematical_spec: Given sorted candidate probabilities p_i>=0 with total mass 1 and threshold P in (0,1], choose m=min{j>=1:sum_{i=1}^j p_i>=P}. Retain [0,m), let Z=sum_{i<m}p_i, and output q_i=p_i/Z in the same order; Z=0 is INVALID.
implementation_prompt: Specify threshold validation, retained-count output, minimum-one rule, renormalization precision, zero-mass failure, and deterministic threshold behavior.

objective: Define categorical sampling from a filtered candidate row.
mathematical_spec: For normalized q[0:m), m>=1, define c_j=sum_{i=0}^j q_i and force c_{m-1}=1 after accumulation. For u in [0,1), select the smallest j with u<c_j; return token_j, q_j, log(q_j), and the RNG counter used for the draw.
implementation_prompt: Specify strict interval boundaries, accumulation precision, rounding-safe final bin, and returned proposal-probability provenance. Sampling must be deterministic for a fixed candidate row and RNG counter.

objective: Define multi-child sampling without replacement for branch expansion.
mathematical_spec: For b<=m, iterate draw d=0..b-1 with residual mass R_d. Select token j among unselected entries using normalized mass q_j/R_d, record conditional proposal probability pi_d=q_j/R_d, set its residual mass to zero, and update R_{d+1}=R_d-q_j; stop when R_d<=0.
implementation_prompt: Specify ordered sibling draws, residual renormalization, deterministic draw ordinals, emitted child order, and exact conditional proposal probability per child so stochastic verification can reconstruct the proposal process.

objective: Define a branch-local cumulative draft score.
mathematical_spec: For node i with ancestors A(i), define score_logp(i)=sum_{n in A(i) including i} log(max(p_n,eps)); root contribution is zero.
implementation_prompt: Specify cumulative path log-probability maintenance when children are appended. Use a configurable numerical floor only for log safety and keep raw local probability separately.

objective: Define length-normalized branch scoring for cross-depth comparison.
mathematical_spec: For non-root node i at depth d_i, score_len(i)=score_logp(i)/(d_i^alpha), alpha>=0; alpha=0 recovers raw cumulative log probability.
implementation_prompt: Specify optional length normalization used only for ranking/pruning. Define alpha configuration and ensure it does not alter stored draft probabilities.

objective: Define diversity-aware sibling scoring to reduce duplicate branch concentration.
mathematical_spec: For sibling child j with rank r_j among siblings, score_div(j)=score_base(j)-lambda*log(1+r_j), lambda>=0, where rank tie-break follows token id.
implementation_prompt: Specify a sibling diversity penalty layered on the base branch score. Keep the penalty deterministic and configurable, and do not mutate model probabilities.

objective: Define a unified branch-ranking key with stable tie-breaking.
mathematical_spec: Rank node i lexicographically by (score_primary descending,depth preference,path_id ascending,node_index ascending), where score_primary is selected from supported scoring modes.
implementation_prompt: Specify the canonical ranking key and score-mode selection used by pruning and scheduling. The comparator must be total and deterministic.

objective: Define global frontier beam pruning under a hard node budget.
mathematical_spec: Given candidate frontier C and budget B, retain the B highest ranked nodes by ID_120, or all if |C|<=B. Pruned nodes remain in history but are not expandable.
implementation_prompt: Specify frontier pruning that chooses expandable leaves while preserving already appended tree nodes for verification/history. Mark pruned lifecycle flags explicitly.

objective: Define probability-mass pruning relative to the best frontier branch.
mathematical_spec: Retain node i when exp(score_logp(i)-s_max)>=tau for tau in (0,1], then apply hard beam pruning if survivors exceed B.
implementation_prompt: Specify relative probability-mass pruning as an optional prefilter before the hard frontier budget. Define stable evaluation in log space.

objective: Define per-parent child-budget allocation from parent branch quality.
mathematical_spec: For q active parents with weights w_i>=0, per-parent caps K_i, and next-level budget B_next, choose integers b_i in [0,K_i] with sum_i b_i<=B_next. Assign any configured mandatory minima first when feasible, then distribute remaining slots by largest remainder of normalized positive weights; ties use the canonical branch order. If sum_i w_i=0, use deterministic equal apportionment.
implementation_prompt: Specify the exact apportionment algorithm, mandatory-minimum feasibility rule, per-parent caps, zero-weight fallback, tie-breaking, and outputs for requested versus granted child counts.

objective: Define entropy-adaptive child counts for uncertain draft distributions.
mathematical_spec: For retained distribution p[0:m), m>=1, H=-sum_i p_i log p_i. Define H_norm=0 when m=1, otherwise H/log(m). Desired width is clamp(round_half_up(b_min+(b_max-b_min)*H_norm),b_min,b_max).
implementation_prompt: Specify entropy precision, m=1 behavior, rounding rule, and desired-width output only. The module must not allocate nodes or bypass the hard integer budget allocator.

objective: Define confidence pruning using the top probability gap.
mathematical_spec: For sorted retained probabilities p_1>=p_2 with p_2=0 when m=1, define gap=p_1-p_2 and require 0<=g_lo<=g_hi<=1. If gap>=g_hi output desired width 1; if gap<=g_lo output configured wide width; otherwise output NO_OVERRIDE.
implementation_prompt: Specify threshold validation, singleton behavior, wide-width source, and a tri-state result so the heuristic cannot ambiguously overwrite scheduler allocation.

objective: Define acceptance-oriented branch utility based on draft probability.
mathematical_spec: Approximate per-token acceptance utility a_t=f(p_draft(t)) with monotone f, default f(p)=p; branch utility U_i=sum_{n in path(i)} log(max(a_n,eps)).
implementation_prompt: Specify the acceptance-oriented utility interface and default probability proxy. Keep it pluggable so later verifier statistics can replace the proxy without changing tree storage.

objective: Define empirical acceptance calibration by probability bucket.
mathematical_spec: Maintain bucket counts (A_b,N_b) and estimate q_b=(A_b+alpha)/(N_b+alpha+beta). Map draft probability p to bucket b(p) and calibrated acceptance estimate q_b.
implementation_prompt: Specify a lightweight beta-binomial calibration table for observed verifier accept/reject outcomes by draft-probability bucket. Define update and lookup interfaces only.

objective: Define acceptance-aware branch scoring using calibrated token estimates.
mathematical_spec: For path i, score_acc(i)=sum_{n in path(i)} log(max(q(p_n),eps)), where q is ID_127 calibration or ID_126 proxy when uninitialized.
implementation_prompt: Specify cumulative acceptance-oriented branch score with a cold-start fallback. Keep verifier feedback ingestion separate from ranking policy.

objective: Define expected accepted-prefix gain for choosing expansion depth.
mathematical_spec: For path probabilities q_1..q_d, expected accepted tokens E_d=sum_{k=1}^d prod_{j=1}^k q_j. Marginal gain Delta_d=prod_{j=1}^d q_j.
implementation_prompt: Specify expected accepted-prefix gain and marginal depth utility from calibrated per-token acceptance estimates. Return metrics for scheduler decisions without directly stopping expansion.

objective: Define a cost-adjusted expansion utility.
mathematical_spec: For candidate action a, J(a)=G_accept(a)-lambda_c*C_compute(a)-lambda_m*C_memory(a), with nonnegative lambdas and normalized cost estimators supplied by the scheduler.
implementation_prompt: Specify the scalar utility contract combining expected accepted gain with draft compute and memory costs. Do not hard-code hardware coefficients; consume scheduler-provided normalized estimates.

objective: Define per-request expansion budgets across depth, nodes, and draft tokens.
mathematical_spec: For budget B=(N_max,D_max,Tok_max,Step_max), track committed usage U and reserved worst-case R componentwise. An action with delta is admissible iff U+R+delta<=B in every component. Reservation increments R; success moves realized usage from R to U; abort releases the reservation exactly once.
implementation_prompt: Specify component counters, reservation handles, commit/release transitions, overflow-safe arithmetic, and invariants preventing double commit, double release, or leaked reservations.

objective: Define a scheduler-ready expansion action record.
mathematical_spec: Action A=(request,node,child_budget,depth,utility,cost_class,flags) references one expandable frontier node and contains no direct pointers to movable arena storage.
implementation_prompt: Specify the POD-style expansion action used between policy and execution layers. Store stable indices/ids and the ranking fields required for batching.

objective: Define fairness-aware selection across concurrent draft requests.
mathematical_spec: For request r maintain virtual finish F_r=max(F_prev,V)+cost_r/weight_r; select admissible actions by smallest F_r, then deterministic request id tie-break.
implementation_prompt: Specify weighted fair queuing semantics for inter-request draft expansion. Define virtual-time state and deterministic tie-breaking without binding to a thread model.

objective: Define batch formation for draft-model forward passes.
mathematical_spec: Partition selected actions by compatibility key (draft_model,backend,dtype,shape_class,sampler_mode). Within each group stable-sort rows by (depth,request_id,node_index), split at Q_max, and emit row_to_action[q], row_to_node[q], plus batch ranges for every produced draft forward call.
implementation_prompt: Specify the compatibility key, deterministic packing/splitting algorithm, output row mappings, and ownership of descriptors passed to the existing draft decode path.

objective: Define scheduler stop rules from marginal acceptance utility.
mathematical_spec: Stop expanding request r when depth limit reached, frontier empty, budget exhausted, cancelled, or max admissible action has J<=J_min after configured minimum depth.
implementation_prompt: Specify the pure stop-decision function used at expansion boundaries. Return reason codes and preserve policy configurability.

objective: Define a two-phase append protocol for batched child creation.
mathematical_spec: For q parents with child counts c_i, compute exclusive offsets o_0=0 and o_i=sum_{j<i}c_j, with C=sum_i c_i. Reserve arena [n,n+C) only if n+C<=M; parent i owns [n+o_i,n+o_i+c_i). Publish node_count=n+C only after every required child field write succeeds.
implementation_prompt: Specify RESERVE, WRITE, COMMIT, and ABORT phases, child-range ownership, capacity failure before writes, reservation release, and the single publication point for node_count.

objective: Define batched parent-to-child metadata propagation.
mathematical_spec: For reserved child j of parent i, set depth_j=depth_i+1, parent_j=i, path_j=derive(path_i,token_j,ordinal_j), and inherit only explicitly whitelisted request flags.
implementation_prompt: Specify the metadata-fill operation for newly reserved children, including stable path-id derivation and controlled flag inheritance.

objective: Define batched local-probability and cumulative-score writes.
mathematical_spec: For emitted child j with exact sampling probability pi_j, require 0<pi_j<=1 and store local_p[j]=pi_j, local_logp[j]=log(pi_j), and cumulative_logp[j]=cumulative_logp[parent[j]]+local_logp[j]. Ranking auxiliaries occupy separate arrays and may not overwrite these proposal values.
implementation_prompt: Materialize exact proposal-probability provenance from the sampling output, including ordered without-replacement conditional probabilities. Define array shapes/types and prohibit later recomputation of local_p from raw logits.

objective: Define next-frontier construction after append and pruning.
mathematical_spec: Let new children C be appended nodes without terminal flags; next frontier F'=Prune(C union carry), where carry is policy-selected unexpanded leaves. Output packed indices only.
implementation_prompt: Specify deterministic construction of the next packed frontier from committed children and optional carried leaves, invoking configured pruning once per depth boundary.

objective: Define expansion-step transaction boundaries.
mathematical_spec: One committed step transforms S_k=(tree,frontier,budgets) through PACK -> DRAFT_DECODE -> SAMPLE -> RESERVE -> WRITE -> PRUNE -> COMMIT. Intermediate outputs remain private to the step. Failure before COMMIT releases reservations and returns exactly S_k plus status; successful COMMIT publishes S_{k+1} and one telemetry record.
implementation_prompt: Specify the phase state machine, inputs/outputs and row mappings at each phase, cleanup rules, cancellation safe points, and commit ordering. Bind execution to the existing draft context/sampler seams rather than creating another runtime loop.

objective: Define CUDA stream ownership for draft expansion stages.
mathematical_spec: Use logical streams s_model and s_post. Record e_model after logits for step k are ready; s_post waits on e_model before sampling/postprocess. Record e_post after all child metadata writes; COMMIT may publish only after e_post completes. Cross-request overlap is legal only when mutable arenas and workspaces do not alias.
implementation_prompt: Specify stream/event ownership, happens-before edges, event reuse, workspace alias constraints, async error propagation, and a synchronous fallback for backends without equivalent primitives.

objective: Define CUDA launch-shape policy for per-row vocabulary sampling work.
mathematical_spec: For row width V choose block size b from supported powers of two and grid rows q; vocabulary work uses strided lanes t=l+kb. Selection policy is a pure function of V, q, dtype, and device limits.
implementation_prompt: Specify launch-configuration selection inputs/outputs for row-wise candidate extraction and sampling kernels. Do not write kernels; define deterministic shape policy and fallback conditions.

objective: Define fused post-logit pipeline boundaries for CUDA.
mathematical_spec: A fused row pipeline is valid only if, for identical logits/config/RNG counters, it returns the same retained token order, valid_count, emitted child order, selected tokens, and exact proposal probabilities as staged ID_112..ID_116. Fusion may consume counters only in the same logical draw order.
implementation_prompt: Specify fusion eligibility, input/output shapes, supported sampler modes, exact equivalence observables, RNG counter consumption, invalid-row behavior, and staged fallback. Filter order and proposal probability provenance may not change.

objective: Define CUDA prefix-sum integration for child-range reservation.
mathematical_spec: For parent child counts c_i, compute offsets o_i=sum_{j<i}c_j and total C=sum c_i on device; detect node-capacity overflow before child writes and surface CAPACITY status.
implementation_prompt: Specify the device-side exclusive-scan interface used by two-phase child append, including output total, overflow check ordering, and synchronization contract.

objective: Define CUDA graph-capture eligibility for repeated expansion shapes.
mathematical_spec: A step is capture-eligible when model/backend, batch shape class, workspace addresses, launch topology, and optional-filter modes are stable; dynamic node indices remain data inputs, not graph structure.
implementation_prompt: Specify a cache key and eligibility predicate for CUDA Graph capture of repeated draft expansion steps. Define invalidation conditions without implementing graph execution.

objective: Define adaptive width control from measured verifier acceptance.
mathematical_spec: Maintain EMA a_hat_r <- beta*a_hat_r+(1-beta)*a_obs. Map width multiplier m=clamp(m0+k*(a_target-a_hat_r),m_min,m_max) and apply it to desired child budgets before hard caps.
implementation_prompt: Specify a bounded adaptive controller that widens/narrows requested branch width from observed verifier acceptance. Keep update cadence and coefficients configurable.

objective: Define adaptive draft-depth control from accepted-prefix yield.
mathematical_spec: Maintain EMA y_hat of accepted drafted tokens per verification. Increase allowed depth by one when y_hat exceeds high threshold and cost budget permits; decrease by one below low threshold, with hysteresis.
implementation_prompt: Specify a hysteretic depth controller driven by accepted-prefix yield and existing budget constraints. Output an effective D_max override only.

objective: Define combined acceptance-oriented expansion policy.
mathematical_spec: For each frontier node compute requested width from entropy/confidence, adjust by acceptance controller, score actions by cost-adjusted acceptance utility, then schedule subject to request budgets and stop rules.
implementation_prompt: Specify the pure policy composition that turns frontier statistics into scheduler actions. Make ordering of width heuristics, acceptance adjustment, scoring, budget filtering, and stop decisions explicit.

objective: Define per-step telemetry needed to tune draft expansion.
mathematical_spec: Record counts and sums sufficient for rows executed, children proposed/kept/pruned, frontier width, depth, entropy, draft probabilities, predicted acceptance utility, model time, postprocess time, and budget stop reason.
implementation_prompt: Specify a fixed telemetry record emitted once per committed expansion step. Use aggregate counters/histograms where possible and keep hot-path recording allocation-free.

objective: Define the sealed draft-tree handoff contract to target verification.
mathematical_spec: Seal immutable arrays token[n], parent[n], depth[n], local_p[n], local_logp[n], path_id[n], flags[n], plus active/leaf indices, request_id, base_position, n, sampler/RNG provenance, and ABI version. For every proposal context that can enter stochastic rejection, seal either exact transformed proposal support using q_offset[c..c+1], q_token[m], q_prob[m] with sum q_prob over each context equal to 1 within tolerance after temperature/top-k/top-p/min-p/bias/grammar transforms, or a versioned immutable replay descriptor that reproduces the same transformed categorical distribution and path-specific sampler history. Record draft token-domain/remap provenance for every q_token. Require equal node-array lengths, parent[i]<i for non-roots, valid active/support ranges, finite nonnegative probabilities, and immutable backing storage until verifier release.
implementation_prompt: Define a retained/non-owning verifier descriptor consumable by the existing target llama_batch/ubatch path. Include exact selected-token proposal probabilities and enough sealed support data or replay state to reconstruct q(k) for residual sampling after rejection, including path-specific grammar/repetition/bias/filter history and token-domain provenance. Include topology, active/leaf set, base position, request identity, sampler/RNG provenance, node-to-target mapping prerequisites, strict validation, ABI/version checks, and explicit lifetime/release rules without copying prompt/KV state.
